## Scope and authority
- Development work ID (e.g. DEV-PR-01; not TRH-P01):
- Explicit authorization and design references:
- Base SHA / head SHA / changed paths:
- Behavior unchanged / intentionally changed:
- API/schema/model-policy changes:

## Required safeguards
- [ ] Original repository and preserved Git refs remain unchanged.
- [ ] No formal project, TRH/FDH MAIN/Goal, budget, scientific evidence, or user authorization was modified.
- [ ] No UNKNOWN request was blindly retried; no mathematical checked status was inferred from software results.
- [ ] No unapproved framework/backend change, legacy assistant activation, Web UI deletion or data migration.
- [ ] New/changed tools were assessed for filesystem, process, network, credential, and model side effects.

## Verification evidence
- Implemented paths / exact code and documentation changes:
- Offline commands, environment isolation, raw results, UTC time and head SHA:
- GitHub Actions run URLs, jobs, conclusions:
- `NOT_EXECUTED` tests / supported platforms / why:
- External HTTP/API requests, subprocesses, filesystem writes, credential handling (nonsecret summary):
- Provenance/third-party license preservation:

## Risk, rollback, and follow-up
- Safety/security and compatibility risks:
- Known limitations, uncovered tests, and recovery/rollback procedure:
- Additional development work proposed (not implicitly authorized):
- Developer declaration: status `IMPLEMENTED` / `TESTED` only where evidenced; independent MAIN review and acceptance still pending.
